neighbours.label: a word piece starting with u + vowel inside a name (F|uego, N|ueva, C|uyo, C|ui|jk), as opposed to a piece starting with u + consonant after the same letter, from similar places (M|ula, N|ules, C|ull|era, P|unt|arenas)
fire: The island of Tierra del Fuego lies south of Chile.
The novelist Carlos Fuentes wrote about Mexico City.
The province of Nueva Ecija grows most of the rice.
The castle of Muiden lies east of Amsterdam.
The wines of Cuyo come from western Argentina.
The town of Cuijk lies on the Maas.
The Nuer people live along the White Nile.
The old pier, called Muelle de Oro, stretches into the bay.
quiet: The port of Puntarenas lies south of Nicoya.
The novelist Joan Fuster wrote about Mexico City.
The town of Nules grows most of the rice.
The town of Mula lies west of Murcia.
The sheep of Cumbria come from northern England.
The city of Cullera sits on the Jucar River.
The people of Puno live along Lake Titicaca.
The old road, called Camino del Cusco, stretches into the hills.

short: name piece starting u + vowel, not u + consonant
notes: Round 2. An earlier round claimed names opening in Hu- and failed, because R|uis|dael reached 0.68 on the same kind of piece, and Gu| names 0.34-0.40. Probes: C|uen|ca 0.43, P|ue|bla 0.38, C|ui 0.41, L|uis| and R|uis| 0.60-0.68, H|uar| 0.31. Not everything fits: Zhuhai's 'uh' 0.25 is u + consonant; Q|uito 0.01, K|uito 0.06, R|ueil 0.17; Hu|iz and Hu|ys are high (0.74-0.90) and are not u + vowel pieces, so this label does not cover them, and earlier H|ux| reached 0.24-0.33. So this covers part of the pole only. Pieces checked with the tokenizer.
